purpose: Archived scripts from ShadowMap development. Nothing here is needed to run or retrain the model. Kept for provenance and reproducibility of the analysis history.
active_pipeline_order: clip_grid.py -> delhi_grid_clipped.geojson (query "National Capital Territory of Delhi, India")
aggregate_density.py -> grid_density.csv (not used by the model; kept for context)
fetch_grid_lst.py -> grid_lst_ndvi.csv (GEE; provides the lst target)
step13_night_lst.py -> grid_lst_night.csv (GEE; MODIS night, observation only)
step30_oof_predictions.py -> adds out-of-fold columns to grid_predictions.csv
archive/analysis: Validation and diagnostic scripts, numbered by development step. These produced the findings in RESULTS.md: spatial autocorrelation range, R2-vs-block-size curve, feature ablations, temporal holdout, albedo causal tests.

archive/superseded.fetch_density.py: ward-era Overpass density fetch, superseded by fetch_density_v3 then by aggregate_density.py
archive/superseded.fetch_density_v3.py: ward-era final density fetch; grid pipeline uses aggregate_density.py
archive/superseded.fetch_heights.py: ward-era OSM building:levels fetch; height dropped, no predictive skill
archive/superseded.fetch_lst_v2.py: ward-era per-scene LST fetch; abandoned for date-mismatch noise
archive/superseded.fetch_lst_v3.py: ward-era LST fetch, superseded by fetch_grid_lst.py
archive/superseded.mop_up.py: ward-era gap filler for rate-limited Overpass cells
archive/superseded.refetch_failed.py: ward-era retry harness for failed Overpass cells
archive/superseded.improve_model.py: ward-era hyperparameter experiment, superseded by train_grid.py
archive/superseded.train_rf_comparison.py: ward-era RandomForest benchmark (R2 0.4829); not adopted, no quantile intervals

archive/ward_pipeline: The original 95-ward pipeline and its FastAPI app (main.py, port 8000). Still functional and untouched. Reported R2 0.4523 under repeated random-split CV, which is inflated by spatial autocorrelation.
note_on_step_numbering: Gaps in step numbers (1,3,18,24-29,31,34,35) were inline commands or patches that produced no standalone script file.
